name: asgi_bare
comment: The populations hybrid_mix cannot produce: an upload that must come back byte for byte (/echo), and a WebSocket echo. Its /stream takes size= and piece= so the bulk population can ask for the many-small-datagrams shape that overflowed the chunk channel.
comment_headers_ignore: transfer-encoding is a per-server FRAMING choice, not a content difference: measured 2026-09-01, uvicorn frames an app body with no declared length as chunked while m0serve buffers it and sends Content-Length. The decoded bytes are identical and the digest still compares them; framing itself is gated by smoke-wsgi-stream and smoke-asgi, not here.
